performance_notes: Complete three movements; no notes truncated to fit target duration.
Original compiled notation MIDI remains unmodified; velocities, gates and shared tempo are editorial.
Notated solo trills realized explicitly with linked upper-diatonic neighbours; not a copied audio performance.
Second movement: violin I/II pizzicato, viola arco pianissimo, cello quiet.
Third movement: Lento/Sirocco q150..178.5; Borea returns to Allegro; initial Tasto Solo respected.
Continuo is discreet organ doubling of bass, not a full realization of every figured-bass indication.
Performance MIDI uses 1000ticks/s timebase at 60BPM; musical tempos are recorded in JSON.
